description: A conditional after the colon is the false result of the first conditional
notes: The spec's grammar (Conditional = Expression "?" Expression ":" Expression) allows both groupings of a conditional after the colon, and no rule chooses one. hashicorp/hcl parses the condition without conditionals and the false result as a whole expression, so conditionals nest to the right (parseTernaryConditional in hclsyntax/parser.go).
